verified.coverageNote: 24254 distinct JDK primitive binary64 patterns enter 190 whitebox backend groups. These are separate from the existing 2140 public Config render programs, freshly compared live and replayed after async transfer. Fourteen mandatory saved-native suites replay 30550 runs; older live reports retain their original source snapshots. Traversal includes 936 runs/906 distinct programs; direct-read overlaps 7033 older requests plus 30 root numeric requests. This is not exhaustive binary64 or full Config conformance.
verified.api: Normalize the runtime nearest shortest decimal into the JDK layout for ordinary binary64 rendering; use a strict integer interval for tiny one-digit subnormal rounding and retain full exact arithmetic on interval boundary overlap. Public APIs unchanged; no rendered-result cache.

performance.scope: Eight exact-render workloads, including ordinary floats, subnormals and decimal powers, and sixteen existing workloads compare current, fixed 0.15 and native Config. Render timers retain the prepared ConfigValue; Java retains options and JS constructs its options object inside each call and include returned text; source parsing, optional partial resolution and final result-array serialization are excluded. The full baseline JS module dependency tree is loaded from the fixed Git commit. Retained workloads compare real Config methods with native Config; construction excluded, immutable operations/getter transport included, final result serialization excluded. Each workload has five fresh processes; Java legacy and retained workloads use separate processes. Startup, I/O and sustained/peak-memory parity are not measured.
